title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-23
lineage: MR > Gans CD > CD > DAE > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the March 23, 1972 Academy of Music show with a smoking Dark Star, blazing Phil on bass and a tight, high‑energy second set.
ai_review.review: The Betty board recording is praised as crystal‑clear and “great sound,” delivering an exceptionally vivid listening experience. The performance is described as one of the hottest of the era – a tight second set highlighted by a sublime Dark Star, fiery Phil on fire, and the wild Pig‑and‑Bob finale on Not Fade Away. Overall the show feels like a preview of the band’s imminent European tour.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, emphasizing both superb soundboard quality and an outstanding musical performance; the consensus is uniformly enthusiastic.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Betty board source noted as crisp and clear throughout; reviewers repeatedly call the sound "great" with no mention of major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, high‑energy second set with seamless transitions; the show is described as a taste of the upcoming European tour.

band_member_comments.Phil: Described as "on fire" and delivering one of his hottest bass performances.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pig (Bill Kreutzmann) and Bob (Mickey Hart) provide an intense, screaming finale on Not Fade Away.
